text:
I'm sorry, it's frustrating to write in three times and still have a dead plant. Under our policy, a plant that dies is covered by the Plant Care Guarantee, which gives **one free replacement** (store credit if it's out of stock) rather than a refund. To claim, go to "My Orders" and submit **at least two photos** (whole plant and a close-up) within the guarantee window, which is **30 days from delivery, or 90 days for Leafy Plus members** on plants ordered while the membership was active. A Plant Care Specialist will review it within **2 business days**, and you don't need to send the plant back.

The policy I have doesn't cover cancelling Leafy Plus or making exceptions to the refund rules, so I can escalate both to a Support Lead if you'd like. If you do cancel, please submit the plant claim first so it's on record.
